_comment: Records what has been reconciled against OpenIPC/firmware, so that a fleet-wide
change there cannot move under this repository unnoticed. See
.github/scripts/check-firmware-drift.py for why this exists and what each key means.
A pinned blob means a human looked at firmware's version of that file and was
satisfied; re-pinning it is the act of looking again.

shadows.note: fpv/lte/venc variant of the generic config; backs 5 gk7205v200/v210 builds
gk7102c variant of gk710x; keeps CONFIG_INPUT for its evdev consumer

builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_ADAPTIVE_LINK: FPV link adaptation; firmware ships the package but no firmware defconfig enables it
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_ATBM_WIFI: ATBM wifi, only retail models here carry the part
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_AUTONIGHT: day/night switching for specific retail models
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_BWM_NG: upstream Buildroot bandwidth monitor, FPV debugging
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_FFMPEG_OPENIPC: only the waybeam/venc profiles need it
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_HOSTAPD: upstream Buildroot; AP mode for the apfpv profiles
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_HOST_LINUX_HEADERS_CUSTOM_3_: upstream Buildroot; the 3.4 kernel families here
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_IW: upstream Buildroot; selected by wifibroadcast-ng, also set directly here

BR2_PACKAGE_JSONFILTER.reason: only devices/apfpv needs it: its own etc/init.d/S99msposd pipes majestic's config.json through jsonfilter, and those two devices do not enable wifibroadcast-ng, which carries the select for every other FPV device. See builder#128, which removed it from the 95 defconfigs that did not.

builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_LINUX_PATCHER_ATHEROS: atheros patching for the FPV profiles
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_MAVFWD: FPV mavlink forwarding; selected by wifibroadcast-ng, also set directly
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_MSPOSD: FPV OSD; selected by wifibroadcast-ng, also set directly
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_ONVIF_SIMPLE_SERVER: ONVIF for retail models that advertise it
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_PHP: upstream Buildroot; the PHP webui profiles
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_RTL8192EU_OPENIPC: wifi driver for specific retail models
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_RTL8811CU_OPENIPC: wifi driver for specific retail models
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_SSV635X_OPENIPC: wifi driver for specific retail models
builder_only_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_UHTTPD: upstream Buildroot; the PHP webui profiles

known_dead_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_APFPV_GREG: no Kconfig in buildroot, firmware or here, so kconfig ignores the line. Set by the four *_apfpv_greg-generic-* devices, which suggests a package that was never landed. Left in place deliberately: removing it is a maintainer's call about those devices, not a side effect of adding this check.
known_dead_symbols.BR2_PACKAGE_WIFIBROADCAST_EXT: no Kconfig anywhere; set in devices/common beside BR2_PACKAGE_WIFIBROADCAST_NG, which does exist. Probably a rename that left this behind. Same reasoning as APFPV_GREG.
